messages:
Carla: Heads-up — cutoff ~6h from now for v0.23. Need: version bump, changelog entries, QA gates, and security sign-off. I opened the release checklist: https://go/internal/release-checks. Ping if blocked. Owners: @Alice (docs), @Ben (QA), @John (sec), @Sara (release).
Ben: On it. Running full smoke now. One flaky in rerank test that's been noisy locally — rerun queued. If everything else is green I can give a conditional thumbs.
John: Quick sec stance: dependency scan done. One low CVSS in a devDependency (eslint-plugin) — not a prod blocker. No changes to runtime deps detected. I'll post formal sign-off after changelog review.
Alice: Docs update: draft changelog at docs/changelog/v0.23.md. Need a one-line note from @Maria about the new routing param. Also updating the upgrade guide for the config rename.
Maria: Pushing the API blurb to the changelog now, ETA ~15m.
Ben: Canary rolling on staging (canary-rc1). Smoke suite is running; I'll watch error-rate and latency for 30m.
devops-bot: Pipeline: staging-canary build #482 succeeded. smoke-suite: 4/5 passed (rerank flaky failed). Details -> https://ci.internal/build/482
Sara: From release side I'm 👍 once docs + Maria's note are in and John signs off. Who will handle tag + draft notes? @Alex?
Alex: I can handle tagging after green. Command I'll run:
```
# tag RC
git tag v0.23.0-rc1
git push origin v0.23.0-rc1
```
Also will create the release draft and attach the changelog.
Ben: Reminder: keep branch `v0.23-patch` ready for hotfixes just in case. If we see any regressions we should cut there.
Carla: Quick ask — if any sec-related change ends up in the notes, mark the changelog entry with the 'security' label so we surface it in release email. Otherwise I'll collate release notes here: https://go/internal/release-notes/drafts/v0.23
John: Posting final quick sign-off: "sec-review: ok" — no blocking issues found.
Maria: API blurb pushed and linked in the changelog.
Ben: Canary holding steady: p50=98ms, no error-rate increase. smoke-suite now 5/5 after rerun.
Alex: Tag pushed and release draft created: https://go/internal/releases/v0.23.0-rc1/draft — proceeding to cutoff in 5m unless objections.
Carla: No objections from me. Rolling forward. :party:
